knowledge_docs.content: Backend roles usually require API design, SQL fluency, testing, and deployment fundamentals.
Docker and automated testing are common screening filters for junior backend hiring.
Strong resumes show measurable API outcomes, data modeling examples, and CI familiarity.
Frontend roles prioritize React or similar frameworks, JavaScript fundamentals, and UI state management.
Portfolio projects with measurable UX outcomes improve interview conversion.
Hiring managers look for TypeScript usage and accessible component patterns.
Data analyst readiness centers on SQL depth, dashboard storytelling, and clean metric definitions.
Projects that combine SQL + visualization + business recommendation stand out.
